arms.name: Human reviewer (literature)
arms.note: Published figures: Roitblat et al. 2010 re-review agreement, TREC-4 inter-assessor overlap, industry throughput and rate cards. Not measured in this study.

experiments.title: Accuracy vs. the standard
experiments.question: How does each arm's recall and precision compare, scored against the same labels?

experiments.title: At the reviewer's operating point
experiments.question: Holding the model to the first-pass reviewer's recall, how much more precise is it, and how much of the collection would a human still read?
experiments.na: Needs a first-pass human review of the same documents; only the TREC Legal collections have one.

experiments.title: Whose side on contested documents
experiments.question: On documents whose first-pass label was appealed, does the model side with the reviewer or with the adjudicator?
experiments.na: Needs appealed and adjudicated documents; only the TREC Legal collections publish them.

experiments.title: Knows when humans disagree
experiments.question: Does low model confidence predict the documents humans contested?
experiments.na: Needs a per-document record of human disagreement (appeals, panel splits, gray flags).

experiments.title: Consistency
experiments.question: How often does the same input get a different answer? Models re-run; humans re-review.
experiments.na: Repeat runs exist for the Mallinckrodt determinism sample; TREC Legal 2010 has a redundantly assessed slice.

experiments.title: Systematic bias
experiments.question: Does the arm over- or under-call responsiveness, and does accuracy depend on document length?

experiments.title: Workflow simulation
experiments.question: Recall against human hours for human-only, model-only, and hybrid review of the same collection.
experiments.na: Simulated on the TREC Legal collections, following Cormack & Grossman's adjudicated-QC design.

experiments.title: Speed and cost
experiments.question: Median seconds per document and dollars per 100,000 documents, with a human reviewer's throughput and rate for scale.
